input.command:
python -c "
import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
d=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv');x=d.shift_cm1.values;y=d.intensity.values
def L(x,a,c,w):return a/(1+((x-c)/(w/2))**2)
def fit(lo,hi,c0s):
    m=(x>lo)&(x<hi)
    f=lambda x,*p:sum(L(x,*p[3*i:3*i+3]) for i in range(len(c0s)))+p[-2]+p[-1]*(x-lo)
    p0=[];
    for c in c0s:p0+=[3000,c,5]
    p0+=[3500,0]
    p,_=curve_fit(f,x[m],y[m],p0=p0);print(np.round(p,2))
fit(360,430,[382.6,405.9])
fit(500,540,[520.6])
fit(430,480,[450])
fit(200,260,[227,243])
"

candidates.evidence: Strong in-plane E2g(1) at 382.8 cm-1 and out-of-plane A1g at 406.2 cm-1 (Δ=23.4 cm-1), the signature MoS2 pair on SiO2/Si at 532 nm; Δ matches ~3 layers.
Δ≈24 cm-1 would be 4L; the 23.4 cm-1 value sits between 3L (~23) and 4L (~24).
Bulk Δ≈25 cm-1 and E2g≈383/A1g≈408; the observed A1g is lower and Δ is smaller than bulk.

properties.name: layers
properties.source: E2g–A1g separation 23.4 cm-1 vs. layer-number calibration of Lee et al., ACS Nano 2010 (1L ~19, 2L ~21–22, 3L ~23, 4L ~24, bulk ~25)

properties.name: phase
properties.source: E2g and A1g only; no J1/J2/J3 modes (~150, 226, 330) expected for 1T

properties.name: defect_level
properties.source: Narrow E2g (2.4 cm-1 FWHM); no obvious defect-activated bands

properties.name: strain_sign
properties.source: E2g at 382.8 cm-1 is in the normal range for few-layer MoS2; no splitting

artifacts.type: Si substrate line (520.5 cm-1) dominates the intensity
Broad Si/SiO2 background ~3300–3900 counts with noise of a few hundred counts; small bumps at 150–300 cm-1 are noise

citations: Lee et al., ACS Nano 4, 2695 (2010): Anomalous lattice vibrations of single- and few-layer MoS2
Chakraborty et al., Phys. Rev. B 85, 161403 (2012)
Li et al., Adv. Funct. Mater. 22, 1385 (2012)
limits: The layer number comes only from the E2g–A1g separation. Strain, doping and substrate effects shift the modes, so 3L versus 4L is not firmly resolved. 2L (Δ~21–22) and bulk (Δ~25) are disfavoured.
No low-frequency shear or breathing modes (<60 cm-1) are in the range, because the data start at 150 cm-1. They would have given an independent layer count.
The LA(M) ~228 cm-1 and 2LA ~447 cm-1 features are at or below the noise level. The 2LA/A1g region is too noisy for a resonance or excitation-condition analysis.
This is a single spectrum with no polarization data, so peak polarization patterns are not classified.
The measured FWHM of the A1g may be influenced by the noise and by an unresolved sloped background. The linewidths are approximate.
